findings.finding: The positive baseline now correctly precedes structure guards, and free_ids/masks/order/step/radius are substantially validated. The structure/budget proof is still incomplete in three concrete ways. First, the finite-positive selector comparisons themselves are not charged. Second, JacobiFactor.a is part of the retained factor but its 21-by-m shape is not validated, while b, v, sigma, and order are. Third, the implemented validator charges 72+3m guard events before p0 (m range 1, free length 1, free ids m, mask partition 42, b shape 22, v shape 1+m, sigma/order/step lengths 3, order permutation m, radius 2). This exceeds the authority's at-most 64+4m selector/structure allowance for m=1 through 7 even before charging the missing selector and factor.a checks, so G04 is not a conservative bound over the full authorized 1<=m<=21 domain.
findings.required_change: Charge the positive selector at its owning entry, validate factor.a as 21-by-m, and consolidate logically atomic structure predicates so the actual charged selector/structure count is at most 64+4m for every m in 1..=21. Keep the baseline before all those charges and preserve the zero-lambda BVLS-03 path without added work. Record or statically demonstrate the resulting count formula before control execution.
